title: cliffortia tuberculata var. muricata
intro: Cliffortia tuberculata var. muricata, commonly known as the Rough Cliffortia or Rough Cliffortia bush, is a plant species in the family Rosaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Cliffortia tuberculata var. muricata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and protecting against oxidative stress. The plant's therapeutic actions also include wound healing, anti-diarrheal, and anti-arthritic properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
